informal_statement: Fix lambda > 1, a set S contained in (0,1], a compact set K contained in (0,1), and a function r from the reals to the reals. If, for every t in S, r(t) belongs to K and is the unique y in K satisfying A3(y) = A4(t), then r is continuous on S. Neither S nor K is required to be an interval.
